# Windows setup and troubleshooting docs audit

Scope: user-facing Windows setup and troubleshooting instructions compared with the
v0.2.0 release notes and the installer/launcher sources. “Unverified” means the
repository evidence does not establish what happens on a real Windows 10/11
computer.

The supplied issue contains the WO-124 text, but `docs/vendor/WO-124.md` is not
present in this checkout. The shallow Git history also does not contain commit
`07fdbcc`; its unreleased status below comes from the supplied issue text.

The v0.2.0 release notes are marked draft, and say that the installer was not
re-checked on a fresh Windows VM (`docs/marketing/release-notes-v0.2.0.md:1-3,80-82`).
The available VM screenshots are from v0.1.0; the handoff records that walkthrough
and its limits (`docs/handoff/wizard-packager.md:40-47`). Treat source-level
installer behavior below as implementation evidence, not proof of a v0.2.0
real-Windows result.

The FAQ links to pictured instructions (`site_src/data/faq.yaml:83-88`). ## Next-release note

The current checkout's finish-page copy says to wait up to 15 seconds
(`packaging/windows/freemyid.iss:31-35,55-56`), but the installer comment explicitly
calls the delay unverified on Windows (`:31-33`). The supplied work-order text says that change is unreleased (`07fdbcc`). Keep
v0.2.0 guidance separate from it; if it ships,
update the quick start and helper guide and verify the actual wait on a Windows
10/11 computer.
